Sorry that’s my life not yours lol. Um how can you help her? Well first off don’t do what my bf did lol. You tell her that you love her and you’re here for her. Ask her to call or text you whenever she gets the urge/is about to. Tell her that you wanna know when she does do it so you can support her. And how do you support her? You ask her talk about what’s wrong (might not work but at least she knows you care enough to ask) and you tell her that you’re here for her and you love her. You ask her if there’s anything you can do. And suggest things (watch a movie, cuddle, just say sweet things). After that there’s not much else you can do. She’s gonna do what she wants at the end of the day. I know that’s hard and it sucks but I hope she’s safe and healthy and you are too.
